title: MZ Face Flip and Text Positioning on MZ

posts.author: rafaeljbi
posts.body:
I know there are some plugins that attempt to solve this issue, but I couldn’t find one that worked reliably in all cases.
So I took some time to create this simple and lightweight solution.
Video preview:
What does this plugin do?​
Allows you to change the
side of the face graphic
inside the message window.
Automatically adjusts the
actor name position
accordingly.
Allows you to
flip the face image horizontally
.
Works together with pop-up / message position plugins.
How to use​
Add the plugin to your
RPG Maker MZ
project.
Use the following text commands at the
beginning of the message
:
\position[1]   // Moves the face to the right side
\flip[1]       // Flips the face image horizontally
-Both commands can be used together.
-Default behavior is preserved if no command is used.
